title.zh: 规定在拉古纳省Siniloan市镇设立水土保持示范站，名称为拉古纳水土保持示范站，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Soil Conservation Demonstration Station in the Municipality of Siniloan Province of Laguna, to Be Known as Laguna Soil Conservation Demonstration Station, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a Soil Conservation Demonstration Station in the Municipality of Siniloan Province of Laguna, to Be Known as Laguna Soil Conservation Demonstration Station, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trạm Trình diễn Soil Conservation tại Thị trấn Siniloan Province Laguna với tên gọi Trạm Trình diễn Laguna Soil Conservation, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสถานีสาธิต Soil Conservation ในเทศบาล Siniloan Province Laguna ในชื่อสถานีสาธิต Laguna Soil Conservation และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Stasiun Percontohan Soil Conservation di Kotamadya Siniloan Province Laguna dengan nama Stasiun Percontohan Laguna Soil Conservation, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Stesen Demonstrasi Soil Conservation di Perbandaran Siniloan Province Laguna dengan nama Stesen Demonstrasi Laguna Soil Conservation, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6484_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established a soil conservation demonstration station in the Municipality of Siniloan, Province of Laguna. The said station shall be under the supervision of the Director of Soils and shall be subject to the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred twenty-two.

The sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the soil conservation demonstration station for the fiscal year nine-teen hundred and seventy-three. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without the Executive approval, June 17, 1972.
